scenes.setting: First-class dining room of the White Agate, noon: Klein eats through the whole menu at Danitz's expense while the pirate gossips about why Just Elland quit the Navy; a crewman stomps in with 'Captain, there's a pirate ship!' and Elland calmly sends the first-class passengers (Donna's family, Cleves) back to their cabins

Room 312: the Red Skull ship (Sea Wolf Johnson, One-Eyed Anderson) closes in; Klein makes Danitz remove his wig and makeup, then hang out of the window by his forearm so the pirates can see Rear Admiral Iceberg's fourth boatswain -- 'I'm a very easy person to get along with, really, as long as you do as I tell you.'
scenes.text_anchor: “Take off your wig,” Klein calmly ordered.

scenes.setting: On the Red Skull: a lookout reports 'a weird guy hanging out the window'; Sea Wolf Johnson raises his binoculars, recognizes Blazing Danitz, concludes the White Agate is Rear Admiral Iceberg's prey and orders everyone to stay far away

Room 305: Cleves at the window with his revolver, Donna's family huddled in the living room with the bodyguards Cecile and Teague on guard -- then, after a few minutes, 'The pirates have left,' to Urdi Branch's confusion
Room 312: Danitz crawls back in, snorting that Klein borrowed his captain's reputation and she hates that; Klein only asks whether her Loen bounty was 26,000 pounds
